blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
This paper presents an overview of the fourteenth edition of the BioASQ challenge, organized in the context of the Conference and Labs of the Evaluation Forum (CLEF) 2026.
BioASQ is an international challenge series that supports progress in biomedical language processing tasks ranging from semantic indexing and information extraction to question answering and summarization.
In 2026, BioASQ included six shared tasks:
a) Task 14b on biomedical semantic question answering.
b) Task Synergy14 on question answering for developing biomedical topics.
c) Task MultiClinSum-2 on multilingual clinical summarization.
d) Task BioNNE-R on extracting relations between nested named entities in Russian and English.
e) Task ELCardioCC on clinical coding in cardiology.
f) Task GutBrainIE on gut-brain interplay information extraction.
Across these six tasks, 87 distinct teams participated, submitting more than 1000 runs overall.
As in previous editions, several submissions reached competitive performance, reflecting the continued progress of state-of-the-art methods across biomedical language processing tasks.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
BioASQ was launched in 2012 to advance large-scale semantic indexing and question answering (QA) in biomedicine, and it has gradually expanded to include additional biomedical language processing tasks [ 73 ] .
It pursues this goal through annual shared tasks and benchmark datasets that capture the real information needs of biomedical experts. These tasks include updated versions of established tracks that remain timely, as well as novel tracks introduced to address emerging biomedical information needs.
Through these shared tasks, research teams worldwide working on clinical coding, information extraction, information retrieval, QA, and summarization in biomedicine gain access to public datasets, a common evaluation infrastructure, and opportunities to exchange ideas through the BioASQ challenges and workshops.
blocks.zh:
BioASQ于2012年推出,以推进生物医学领域的大规模语义索引和问答(QA),并逐渐扩展到包括额外的生物医学语言处理任务[73].
它通过收集生物医学专家真实信息需要的年度共同任务和基准数据集来实现这一目标。 这些任务包括更新仍然及时的既定航线,以及为解决新出现的生物医学信息需求而引入的新航线。
通过这些共同的任务,全世界从事临床编码、信息提取、信息检索、质量评估以及生物医学总结的研究小组获得了公共数据集、共同评价基础设施和通过生物安全标准挑战和讲习班交换意见的机会。

blocks.en:
This paper presents a compact overview of the shared tasks, the respective datasets, the participating systems, and their performance in the fourteenth BioASQ challenge, held as a CLEF 2026 lab.
The rest of the paper is structured as follows.
Section 2 first gives a general overview of the shared tasks in BioASQ for 2026, together with the respective datasets.
Section 3 then offers a condensed description of participation in each shared task.
More detailed descriptions of systems can be found in the corresponding extended task overviews and in the proceedings of the BioASQ lab.
Next, Section 4 briefly reports the performance of the systems in each task, using state-of-the-art evaluation measures or manual assessment.
Finally, Section 5 presents some overall conclusions.

blocks.en: 2.1 Task 14b

BioASQ task 14b is the fourteenth edition of the established BioASQ task b on biomedical QA [ 53 ] . In 2026, the task was organized in three phases: i) Phase A, where systems received biomedical questions in English and had to retrieve relevant PubMed documents and snippets. ii) Phase A+, where systems had to produce both “exact” and “ideal” answers. Depending on the question type, the exact answer is either yes or no (yes/no), a single entity name, such as a disease or gene (factoid), or a set of entity names (list). The ideal answer is a paragraph-length response for all question types. iii) Phase B, where BioASQ experts supplied selected relevant material for each question and systems had to generate answers using this additional evidence.
blocks.zh: BioASQ任务14b是关于生物医学QA的既定BioASQ任务b的第十四版[53]. 2026年,任务分三个阶段安排: (一)阶段. A,系统收到英文生物医学问题,必须检索相关的PubMed文件和片段。 (二) A+阶段,即系统必须同时产生“准确”和“理想”的答案。 根据问题类型,确切的答案是是还是否(是/否),一个单一的实体名称,如疾病或基因(factoid),或一组实体名称(list). 理想的答案是针对所有问题类型的段落长度的答复. 页:1 B阶段,BioASQ专家为每个问题提供了选定的相关材料,系统必须利用这些补充证据提出答案。

blocks.en: 2.2 Task Synergy 14
blocks.zh: 2.2 任务协同14

blocks.en:
BioASQ task Synergy was first introduced in 2021 to encourage research on developing biomedical topics, such as COVID-19 [ 31 , 32 ] .
The task is designed as an ongoing dialogue in which experts pose open-ended questions on developing topics, without knowing in advance whether a definitive answer can already be produced. Systems return relevant material, namely documents and snippets, and the experts assess it. They then provide feedback about relevance and indicate whether the available evidence is sufficient by marking questions as ready to answer . The process is repeated across four rounds, with each round considering new material from the evolving document resource [ 54 ] 1 1 1 As of 2023, this evolving document resource is PubMed [ 48 ] .
For questions marked as ready to answer , systems also provide exact and ideal answers, which the experts assess, providing feedback that can help systems improve their answers in later rounds.
Additionally, the experts may mark a question as closed when they receive a fully satisfactory answer that is not expected to change, or when the question is no longer of interest.
blocks.zh:
BioASQ任务协同首次引入于2021年,目的是鼓励开发生物医学主题的研究,如COVID-19[31,32].
这项任务的目的是不断进行对话,专家们在对话中就发展专题提出不限名额的问题,而事先又不知道是否能够得出一个明确的答复。 系统返回有关材料,即文件和片段,由专家进行评估。 他们随后就相关性提供反馈,并指明现有证据是否足够,将问题标明为随时可以回答的问题。 这一过程分四轮重复进行,每轮审议来自不断发展的文件资源的新材料[54]11 1,截至2023年,这一不断发展的文件资源是PubMed [48].
对于标明为随时可以回答的问题,系统还提供专家评估的准确和理想的答案,提供反馈,帮助系统在以后的几轮中改进答案.
此外,当专家得到一个预期不会改变的完全满意的答复时,或者当问题不再引起兴趣时,他们可以认为一个问题已经结束。

blocks.en:
A training dataset of 400 questions on developing topics, incrementally annotated with relevant material and answers, is available from earlier versions of task Synergy [ 52 , 51 , 50 , 57 , 56 ] .
In task Synergy 14 , 63 new questions on developing health topics were added, namely cortisol biology and Cushing syndrome, cancer treatment response, molecular and genetic mechanisms, infectious diseases and prophylaxis, diagnostic methods, and mental health topics.
Additionally, 3 questions that remained open from earlier editions were added in round two to be enriched with newer evidence and revised answers [ 53 ] .
Overall, 66 distinct questions were considered in the four Synergy 14 rounds, which contained 63, 66, 64, and 48 questions, respectively. The corresponding distinct yes/no, list, factoid, and summary counts were 15, 17, 14, and 20 in total.

blocks.en: 2.3 Task MultiClinSum-2
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 任务多ClinSum-2

blocks.en: Clinical content, including patient medical records, detailed clinical case reports, and electronic health records (EHRs), continues to grow rapidly across healthcare systems worldwide, covering numerous languages beyond English and reflecting the global scope of medical practice. The extensive length of many clinical reports presents a significant barrier for healthcare professionals who must efficiently extract essential clinical information from these documents. Recent advances in generative and encoder-based transformer models have demonstrated considerable potential for automated summarization, offering the capability to synthesize comprehensive clinical narratives into concise summaries that preserve relevant patient details and clinical findings while significantly reducing document length. Such developments highlight the need to rigorously assess and compare the performance of clinical summarization systems across multiple languages.
blocks.zh: 临床内容,包括病人病历、详细的临床病例报告以及电子健康记录,在世界各地的保健系统继续迅速增长,涵盖英语以外的多种语言,反映了全球医疗实践的范围。 许多临床报告篇幅很长,对保健专业人员来说是一个重大障碍,他们必须有效地从这些文件中获取必要的临床信息。 最近基因和编码式变压器模型的进步表明,自动化归纳的潜力相当大,提供了将综合临床叙事综合成简明摘要的能力,以保存相关的患者细节和临床结果,同时大幅缩短文件长度. 这些事态发展突出表明,必须严格评估和比较多种语言临床综合系统的表现。

blocks.en: Building on the first edition of the task, we present MultiClinSum-2, the second edition of our shared task focusing on automatic summarization of clinical case reports, now expanded to 15 languages: English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Catalan, Norwegian, Danish, Romanian, German, Greek, Dutch, Czech, and Swedish. The task leverages a comprehensive corpus of full clinical cases paired with reference summaries derived from biomedical literature. Table 2 reports the corpus statistics for each language sub-track.

blocks.en: 2.4 Task BioNNE-R
blocks.zh: 2.4 任务BONNE-R

blocks.en: In the BioNNE-R Shared Task [ 63 ] , we address the challenge of extracting relations between nested named entities, i.e. entities that contain other entities within their boundaries, from biomedical texts. Most relation extraction datasets are annotated with flat named entities, which cannot contain other named entities. Extraction of relations between nested entities provides additional challenges for models: a relation can connect an uppermost entity and its internal entity, or intersect boundaries of an uppermost entity connecting its internal entity and some external entity. These issues can be problematic even for state-of-the art relation extraction approaches [ 77 ] . One of the key features of BioNNE-R shared task is the focus on relations between nested entities that are (i) derived from the annotations in the NEREL-BIO corpus [ 37 , 38 ] and (ii) supplemented by newly annotated data in both English and Russian. The annotation includes 8 entity types and 14 relation types. The competition was organized into three subtasks that fell under two evaluation tracks: 1. Two monolingual tracks that treated English and Russian data independently; 2. Bilingual track that required a single bilingual model for the combined Russian and English data. Data statistics for both tracks are summarized in tables 4 and 4 . All BioNNE-R materials can be found on the shared task’s GitHub 2 2 2 https://github.com/nerel-ds/NEREL-BIO/tree/master/BioNNE-R and Codabench pages 3 3 3 https://www.codabench.org/competitions/13132/ .
blocks.zh: 在BioNENE-R共享任务[63]中,我们处理从生物医学文本中提取巢命名实体,即在其边界内包含其他实体的实体之间的关系的挑战. 大多数关系提取数据集都带有平面命名实体的注释,它们不能包含其他命名实体. 巢实体之间关系的提取为模型提供了额外的挑战:一种关系可以连接一个最上层实体及其内部实体,或者一个最上层实体连接其内部实体和一些外部实体的边界交叉. 这些问题甚至对于最先进的关系提取方法都可能存在问题[77]. BioNNE-R共同任务的一个关键特征是注重巢实体之间的关系,这种关系是(一) 源自NEREL-BIOOecuration[37,38]中的说明,(二) 由新附加说明的英文和俄文数据加以补充。 注释包括8个实体类型和14个关系类型。 比赛分为三个子任务,属于两个评审轨道: 1. 独立处理英文和俄文数据的两条单一语言音轨; 2. 双语音轨,要求俄语和英文综合数据采用单一双语模式. 这两条轨道的数据统计摘要见表4和表4。 所有生物NNE-R材料均可在共同任务的GitHub 2 2上找到 https://github.com/nerel-ds/NEREL-BIO/tree/master/BioNNE-R和Codabench页 3 3 https://www.codabench.org/competions/13132/ 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2.5 Task ELCardioCC
blocks.zh: 2.5 任务 ELCardioCC

blocks.en: Cardiovascular diseases affect a significant portion of the global population, accounting for 32% of global deaths according to WHO 4 4 4 https://www.who.int/health-topics/cardiovascular-diseases . Automated clinical coding plays a crucial role in transforming unstructured real-world medical data gathered from patients into structured information, facilitating clinical research, healthcare analytics, and clinical decision support. This need is particularly important for Greek hospitals, where discharge letters are often stored as free-text clinical narratives, making large-scale analysis, interoperability, and efficient reuse of clinical knowledge challenging. The digitization and structuring of discharge letters through automated ICD-10 coding can therefore substantially improve electronic health record management and support downstream healthcare applications. However, existing research predominantly focuses on English clinical text, leaving other languages, such as Greek, underrepresented. To address this gap, the ELCardioCC shared task [ 13 ] focuses on the automatic assignment of cardiology-related ICD-10 codes to discharge letters collected from Greek hospitals.
blocks.zh: 根据卫生组织4 4 4 https://www.who.int/health-topics/cardio血管病。 自动化临床编码在将从患者收集的非结构化现实世界医疗数据转化为结构化信息、促进临床研究、保健分析以及临床决策支持方面发挥着关键作用。 这种需要对于希腊的医院来说特别重要,出院信往往作为自由文字的临床叙事存储,使得大规模分析,互操作性,以及临床知识的有效再利用成为挑战. 因此,通过自动ICD-10编码对放电信进行数字化和结构化可大大改进电子健康记录管理并支持下游的保健应用。 然而,现有的研究主要集中于英语临床文本,留下了希腊语等其他语言,代表性不足. 为了弥补这一差距,ELCardioCC共同的任务[13]侧重于自动分配与心脏病学有关的ICD-10代码,以排出从希腊医院收集的信件.

blocks.en: In detail, participants in the ELCardioCC task of 2026 were asked to develop artificial intelligence systems capable of processing Greek cardiology discharge letters and predicting the appropriate ICD-10 diagnostic codes at the document level. To accomplish this goal, participants could employ a wide range of natural language processing and machine learning techniques, including Named Entity Recognition (NER), Entity Linking (EL), and multi-label classification methods. The provided corpus was specifically designed to support experimentation with such approaches, enabling systems to identify clinically relevant concepts and map them to standardized medical knowledge in support of ICD-10 prediction. The training dataset includes 2,500 discharge letters, while the test set comprises 500 letters. System performance was evaluated using the F1 score.
blocks.zh: 详细来说,2026年ELCardioCC任务的参与者被要求开发能够处理希腊心脏放电信的人工智能系统,并预测文件层面适当的ICD-10诊断代码. 为了实现这一目标,参与者可以使用多种自然语言处理和机器学习技术,包括命名实体识别(NER)、实体链接(EL)和多标签分类方法。 所提供的教程是专门用来支持这些方法的实验,使系统能够确定临床相关概念并将其映射到标准化的医疗知识中,以支持ICD-10预测。 训练数据集包括2500个放电字母,而测试数据集包括500个字母. 系统性能使用F1分数评价.

blocks.en: 2.6 Task GutBrainIE
blocks.zh: 2.6 任务GutBraine

blocks.en:
The scientific literature on the gut-brain axis, which investigates the interplay between the gut microbiota and neurological and psychiatric disorders, is rapidly expanding [ 7 , 17 , 2 , 10 ] .
PubMed publications on this topic more than doubled between 2020 and 2025, increasing from approximately 600 to more than 1,500 articles per year, making it increasingly challenging for clinicians and researchers to keep track of new findings.
blocks.zh:
研究肠道微生物与神经和精神障碍相互作用的肠道-脑轴的科学文献正在迅速扩展[7,17,2,10].
2020年至2025年期间,关于这一主题的普布梅德出版物翻了一番多,从每年约600篇文章增加到1500多篇文章,使临床医生和研究人员越来越难以跟踪新的研究结果。

blocks.en: For this reason, we propose the second edition of the GutBrainIE task, which aims to foster the development of Information Extraction (IE) systems able to identify, normalize, and structure relevant biomedical knowledge from scientific publications related to the gut-brain axis and its implications in Parkinson’s, Alzheimer’s, and Multiple Sclerosis [ 41 ] .
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议第二版的GutBraine任务,目的是促进开发信息提取系统,以便能够从科学出版物中找出、实现生物医学知识的正常化和结构化,这些科学出版物涉及脑震荡轴及其在帕金森氏症、阿尔茨海默症和多发性硬化症中的影响[41]。

blocks.en:
Compared with the previous edition, the 2026 edition of GutBrainIE introduces two main changes: the dataset has been substantially expanded, from around 1,500 to more than 6,000 annotated documents, and concept-level annotations have been added [ 40 , 42 ] . Accordingly, we kept two subtasks from the previous edition: Named Entity Recognition (NER), which requires the identification and classification of entity mentions according to the GutBrainIE annotation schema, and Mention-level Relation Extraction (M-RE), which requires the identification and labeling of relations between specific entity mentions.
We further introduced two new subtasks: Named Entity Recognition and Disambiguation (NERD), which extends NER by requiring each detected entity mention to be linked to a concept identifier from reference biomedical vocabularies, and Concept-level Relation Extraction (C-RE), which evaluates relations at the level of linked concepts rather than surface mentions.
blocks.zh:
与上一期相比,2026年版的GutBraine引入了两大变化:数据集大幅扩展,从约1500个附加说明的文件增加到6000多个,并增加了概念级说明[40,42]. 因此,我们保留了前一版的两个子任务:命名实体识别(NER),它要求根据GutBraine注解计划对提到的实体进行识别和分类;和提及一级关系提取(M-RE),它要求识别和标注具体实体之间的关系。
我们进一步引入了两个新的子任务:命名实体识别和分裂(NERD),它通过要求每个被检测到的实体与参考生物医学词汇中的概念标识联系起来来扩展NER;概念层面的关联提取(C-RE),它从关联的概念层面而不是表面提及的角度评价关系。

The Development and Test sets contain only expert annotations.

blocks.en: 3 Overview of participation
blocks.zh: 3个 与会情况概述

blocks.en:
Overall, 87 distinct teams took part across the six shared tasks of the fourteenth edition of the BioASQ challenge. Participation by task amounted to 45 teams in task 14b, 7 in Synergy14, 10 in MultiClinSum-2, 7 in BioNNE-R, 6 in ELCardioCC, and 16 in GutBrainIE. Most teams focused on a single task, although four teams submitted to both task 14b and Synergy14.
This section gives a concise overview of the approaches developed by the participating teams for each BioASQ task. More detailed descriptions will be provided in the extended overview of each task [ 53 , 62 , 63 , 14 , 41 ] , and system-specific papers will appear in the
proceedings of the fourteenth BioASQ workshop 5 5 5 https://www.bioasq.org/workshop2026/proceedings .
blocks.zh:
总体而言,有87个不同的小组参加了第十四版BioASQ挑战的六项共同任务。 参与任务的有45个小组参与任务14b,7个小组参与协同14,10个小组参与MultiClinSum-2,7个小组参与BioNone-R,6个小组参与ELCardioCC,16个小组参与GutBraine。 大多数团队都专注于一项单一的任务,尽管有四个团队同时提交了任务14b和协同14.
本节简要概述各参与小组为每项BioASQ任务制定的办法。 将在对每项任务的扩大概述中提供更详细的说明[53、62、63、14、41],系统特有的文件将载于
第14次会议 BioASQ讲习班 5 5 5 https://www.biosq.org/workshop2026/proceedings 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Task 14b

Task 14b attracted 45 teams, which produced 821 submissions from 151 distinct systems across the four batches and the three phases A, A+, and B.
Participation remained as high as in the previous edition, with a slightly larger number of submitted systems and runs, showing that the task continues to be timely and relevant [ 47 ] .
Specifically, 34, 28, and 36 teams competed in Phases A, A+, and B, respectively, with 100, 81, and 112 distinct systems and 261, 241, and 319 submissions. Twenty-three teams participated in all three phases.
As in previous years, the open-source system OAQA [ 78 ] , which achieved top performance in older editions of BioASQ [ 30 ] , was used as a baseline for phase B exact answers .
blocks.zh:
任务14b吸引了45个小组,从四个批次和A+和B三个阶段的151个不同系统共提交了821份来文。
参与程度仍然与上一期一样高,提交和运行的系统数目略多,表明这项任务仍然及时和相关[47]。
具体而言,在A阶段、A+阶段和B阶段分别有34支、28支和36支队伍参加竞争,分别有100支、81支和112个不同的系统以及261支、241支和319支。 23支球队参加了所有三个阶段.
与往年一样,开源系统OAQA[78]在旧版BioASQ[30]中取得了最高性能,作为B阶段确切答案的基准.

blocks.en:
The participating systems explored a broad set of retrieval and generation methodologies.
Beyond traditional retrieval methods like BM25, systems utilized dense and hybrid retrieval models, which were further refined using techniques such as re-ranking, query-expansion, ontology-guided enhancements and multi-query strategies.
Most approaches relied on multi-stage Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines that combined these methods with state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) (including GPT‑4/5 variants, Gemini, Claude, Llama‑3, BioMistral, OpenBioLLM, Qwen). Furthermore, these systems also integrated various advanced techniques such as few-shot prompting, chain‑of‑thought reasoning, ensemble voting, prompt optimization, and agentic workflows. [ 3 , 60 , 71 , 25 , 82 , 72 , 4 , 74 , 58 , 33 , 75 , 66 , 1 , 5 , 61 , 15 , 68 , 28 ]
blocks.zh:
参与系统探讨了一系列广泛的检索和生成方法。
除了BM25等传统检索方法外,系统还采用了密集和混合的检索模式,这些模式利用了重新排序、查询扩展、肿瘤指导增强和多管战略等技术得到进一步完善。
大多数方法依赖于多阶段检索增强型(RAG)管道,这些管道将这些方法与最先进的大语言模型(LLMs)相结合(包括GPT‐4/5变体,双子座,克劳德,Llama‐3,BioMistral,OpenBioLLM,Quen). 此外,这些系统还融合了各种先进技术,如少发催促、链条“思维推理、共同投票、迅速优化和代理工作流程。 [3、60、71、25、82、72、4、74、58、33、75、66、1、5、61、15、68、28]

blocks.en: 3.2 Task Synergy 14
blocks.zh: 3.2 任务协同14

blocks.en:
In BioASQ 14, seven teams participated in task Synergy14. They submitted 79 runs from 18 distinct systems.
Four of these teams also participated in task 14b, while the remaining three focused on Synergy14.
The participating systems employed a variety of approaches including hybrid retrieval methods, which combined BM25 with cross-encoder models, task-specific LLMs with evidence-grounded prompting, and RAG architectures that utilized various prompting and optimization techniques [ 3 , 18 , 68 , 60 , 70 ] .
More detailed descriptions for some of the systems will be available in the workshop proceedings.
blocks.zh:
在BioASQ 14中,7支队伍参加了任务协同14. 它们提交的79份来自18个不同的系统。
其中4支球队也参加了任务14b,其余3支则专注于协同14.
参与系统采用了多种方法,包括混合检索方法,将BM25与跨编码器模型相结合,将特定任务的有限责任模型与有证据依据的提示相结合,以及利用各种促进和优化技术的RAG结构[3、18、68、60、70]。
某些系统的更详细的说明将在讲习班会议记录中提供。

blocks.en: 3.3 Task MultiClinSum-2
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 任务多ClinSum-2

blocks.en: In general, participation in the task was very satisfactory, with a broader engagement reflecting the expanded multilingual coverage of this second edition. A total of 9 teams submitted at least one run of their predictions, resulting in 75 runs across all sub-tracks, with each team allowed to submit up to 5 runs per sub-track. As expected, the highest participation was observed in the English sub-track, with 7 teams submitting 20 runs, followed by Spanish (5 teams, 14 runs) and Portuguese (5 teams, 9 runs). Catalan and Dutch also attracted considerable attention, with 4 and 3 teams respectively. Norwegian was the only language that received no submissions, although full coverage was ensured through the developed baseline systems. Table 6 presents the participation received per language sub-track.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,参与这项任务非常令人满意,更广泛的参与反映出第二版的多语种覆盖面扩大。 共有9支队伍提交了至少1次预测,导致75次横跨所有亚轨,每个亚轨允许最多5次提交. 如所料,参加人数最多的是英语分赛道,有7支队伍提交20次跑步,其次是西班牙语(5支队伍,14次跑步)和葡萄牙语(5支队伍,9次跑步). 加泰罗尼亚语和荷兰语也引起了相当的注意,分别有4支和3支球队参赛. 挪威语是唯一没有收到任何呈文的语言,尽管通过已开发的基准系统确保了全部涵盖范围。 表6按语文分轨列出收到的参与情况。

blocks.en: 3.4 Task BioNNE-R
blocks.zh: 3.4 任务BONNE-R

blocks.en: In total, we have received 20 Codabench registrations for the BioNNE-R task, with 7 teams submitting predictions during evaluation. All seven participated in the English subtask, and five each in the Russian and bilingual subtasks.
blocks.zh: 我们总共收到了20个Codabench公司注册的BioNENE-R任务,其中7个小组在评价期间提交了预测。 七人全部参加英语子任务,五人各参加俄语和双语子任务.

blocks.en: Most teams framed nested relation extraction as a pair-classification problem: candidate entity pairs were enumerated, encoded with typed entity markers inserted at span boundaries, and classified by a fine-tuned transformer with an explicit no-relation class. Encoder choices reflected the bilingual setting, with biomedical English models such as BioBERT [ 20 ] and BioLinkBERT [ 79 ] used for the English subtask and multilingual models such as mDeBERTa-v3 [ 23 ] , XLM-RoBERTa [ 9 ] , and multilingual BERT [ 12 ] for the Russian and bilingual subtasks. As the inference-time candidate set is dominated by negative pairs, nearly all teams applied postprocessing to control precision: schema-based filtering of entity-type pairs unseen in training, per-class threshold calibration on the development set, and distance- or sentence-boundary-based candidate pruning. Several teams explored alternatives to the standard classifier: HSE NLP Team used an LLM pipeline to synthesize training examples for rare relation types, aakobiakova fine-tuned an 8B-parameter LLM with LoRA [ 24 ] and log-probability inference, and LODAC-NII complemented a typed-marker classifier with a document-level relational graph model. More detailed system descriptions are available in the extended task overview [ 63 ] .
blocks.zh: 大多数团队将嵌套关系提取设定为对等分类问题:候选实体对被列出,编码时插入了跨边界的打字实体标记,并被一个有明确无关系类的微调变压器分类. Encoder选择反映了双语设置,BioBERT[20]和BioLinkBERT[79]等生物医学英语模型被用于英语子任务,mDeBERTa-v3[23],XLM-RoBERTA[9]等多语种模型用于俄语和双语子任务. 由于推断时间候选人组合以负对数为主,几乎所有的团队都应用了后处理来控制精度:在训练中看不见的实体型对数进行基于计划的过滤,在开发组合上进行每级阈值校准,以及基于距离或句子界限的候选人挤压. 一些小组探讨了标准分类器的替代办法: HSE NLP Team使用LLM管道合成稀有关系类型的训练实例,akobiakova用LORA[24]和日志概率推论对8B参数LLM进行了微调,LODAC-NII用文件级关系图模型补充了打字标记分类器. 更详细的系统说明见扩展任务概述[63]。

blocks.en: 3.5 Task ELCardioCC
blocks.zh: 3.5 任务 ELCardioCC

blocks.en: The ELCardioCC task engaged six teams, with a total of 19 systems submitted in addition to our baseline model.
blocks.zh: 除了我们的基线模型之外,欧洲气候合作组织的任务还吸收了6个小组参加,共提交了19个系统。

blocks.en: The submitted systems reveal a strong trend toward hybrid and multi-stage architectures that combine Named Entity Recognition (NER), entity linking, and document-level ICD-10 classification. Several teams framed the task as a pipeline problem, first identifying clinically relevant spans and then mapping them to standardized diagnostic codes. Some approaches relied on explicit mention detection followed by concept normalization or classification, often leveraging Greek-specific transformer backbones such as BERT-based Greek models and multilingual variants including XLM-RoBERTa. These systems enriched semantic representations through hierarchical medical knowledge, entity linking strategies, translated terminologies, and external clinical resources. A common motivation behind these designs was to reduce the complexity of the original multi-label document classification task by transforming it into finer-grained mention-level prediction problems, enabling more precise handling of clinical concepts and improving generalization across rare ICD-10 categories.
blocks.zh: 所提交的系统显示出一种强有力的趋势,即混合式和多阶段结构将命名实体识别(NER)、实体链接和文件一级的ICD-10分类结合起来。 一些小组将这项任务视为一个管道问题,首先确定与临床相关的跨度,然后将其绘制成标准化诊断代码。 一些方法依赖在概念正常化或分类之后明确提及检测,往往利用希腊特有的变压器主干线,如基于BERT的希腊模型和包括XLM-RoBERTa在内的多语种变体。 这些系统通过分级医学知识,实体联系战略,翻译术语,以及外部临床资源,丰富了语义表达. 这些设计背后的一个共同动机是降低原始多标签文件分类任务的复杂程度,将它转化为更细化的提及层次的预测问题,使临床概念得到更精确的处理,并改善对罕见的ICD-10类的概括.

blocks.en: Another clear trend was the extensive use of ensemble learning, curriculum learning, and specialized optimization strategies to address class imbalance and improve robustness. Multiple teams combined heterogeneous models using weighted voting, routing mechanisms, or metaheuristic search procedures rather than relying on a single architecture. For example, some teams explored sophisticated ensemble frameworks integrating precision-oriented and recall-oriented subnetworks, threshold tuning, asymmetric loss functions, and declarative search strategies for model fusion. These methods highlight the growing emphasis on balancing performance across both frequent and long-tail diagnostic labels, a critical challenge in clinical coding tasks. At the same time, even simpler baselines based on Greek BERT models demonstrated the importance of strong language-specific pretrained transformers as foundational components. Overall, the approaches indicate a broader movement toward combining deep contextual language models with structured clinical knowledge, ensemble optimization, and task decomposition techniques to achieve accurate and scalable automated ICD-10 coding systems for cardiovascular discharge summaries.
blocks.zh: 另一个明显的趋势是广泛使用综艺学习、课程学习和专门优化战略,以解决班级不平衡和提高稳健性。 多个团队利用加权投票、路由机制或元搜索程序,而不是依赖单一架构,将各种模式结合在一起。 例如,一些团队探索了复杂的综艺框架,将精准导向和召回导向的子网络,阈值调和,不对称丢失功能,以及模式核聚变的申报搜索策略结合起来. 这些方法凸显出人们越来越重视在频繁和长尾诊断标签上平衡性能,这是临床编码任务中的一个关键挑战. 同时,甚至基于希腊BERT模型的更简单的基线也证明了强大的语言特异性预训变压器作为基础组件的重要性. 总体而言,这些方法表明,在将深层语系模型与结构化临床知识、全聚优化和任务分解技术相结合,以实现心血管释放摘要的准确和可扩展的ICD-10自动编码系统方面,出现了更广泛的运动。

blocks.en: 3.6 Task GutBrainIE
blocks.zh: 3.6 任务GutBraine

blocks.en:
The GutBrainIE task registered 18 participating teams.
Among these, 17 teams participated in NER, 14 in NERD, 11 in M-RE, and 10 in C-RE.
blocks.zh:
GutBrainIE任务注册了18个参与团队.
其中参加NER的有17支球队,NERD有14支球队,M-RE有11支球队,C-RE有10支球队.

blocks.en:
For NER, most teams adopted token classification approaches based on biomedical pretrained transformer models, including PubMedBERT, BioLinkBERT, BiomedBERT, and BioMedELECTRA, often combined with CRF layers [ 21 , 79 , 8 ] .
Several systems used GLiNER-style models fine-tuned on the GutBrainIE training data [ 80 ] .
A common strategy was to leverage the quality-based stratification of the training set through filtering, re-weighting, and relabeling of noisier data.
Many teams also employed ensemble methods, combining models trained with different architectures, hyperparameters, or annotation subsets.
blocks.zh:
对于NER,大多数团队都采用了基于生物医学预训变压器模型的符号分类方法,包括PubMedBERT,BioLinkBERT,BioMedBERT,和BioMedELECTRA,它们经常与通用报告格式层结合[21,79,8].
多个系统在GutBrainIE训练数据上使用了GLINER风格的模型微调[80].
一项共同战略是通过过滤、重新加权和重新贴标签来对培训进行质量分层。
许多团队还采用了综艺方法,结合了经过不同架构,超参数或注释子集培训的模型.

blocks.en:
For NERD, most participants extended their NER pipelines with a Named Entity Linking (NEL) component.
Common strategies included dictionary-based matching, SapBERT-style biomedical embeddings, nearest-neighbor retrieval, and concept-definition encoders [ 35 , 19 , 76 ] .
blocks.zh:
就NERD而言,大多数参与者都用命名实体链接(NEL)部分扩展了NER管道。
共同的战略包括基于词典的匹配,SapBERT风格的生物医学嵌入,近邻检索,以及概念定义编码器[35,19,76].

blocks.en:
Across the RE subtasks, participants mainly relied on sequence classification approaches using biomedical pretrained language models finetuned to perform classification of entity pairs marked in-line.
Common strategies included type-based constraints, negative sampling, and threshold tuning. Some teams also experimented with LLMs using prompt- and RAG-based approaches.
blocks.zh:
在整个RE子任务中,参与者主要依靠使用生物医学预训语言模型进行精细调整的序列分类方法,对线上标注的实体对进行分类.
共同战略包括基于类型的限制、负面取样和门槛调整。 一些小组还采用基于快速和RAG的方法试用了LLMS。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Task 14b

This section reports the evaluation measures and preliminary results for task 14b.
The evaluation in task 14b combines expert manual assessment of system responses with automatic scoring using established measures [ 39 ] , as in earlier editions of the task [ 47 , 49 ] . Table 9 summarizes the official measures by response and question type, based on the preliminary results.
The final results will become available after the BioASQ experts complete manual assessment and enrich the ground truth with any additional relevant items, answer elements, and synonyms. The online results pages for Phase A 6 6 6 https://participants-area.bioasq.org/results/14b/phaseA/ , Phase A+ 7 7 7 https://participants-area.bioasq.org/results/14b/phaseAplus/ , and Phase B 8 8 8 https://participants-area.bioasq.org/results/14b/phaseB/ will be updated when final results are available.

blocks.en:
Table 9 reports the batch-level document and snippet retrieval performance of systems participating in Phase A of task 14b. Document retrieval was strongest in the first batch and lower in the later batches, with an average top score across batches of 0.142 ± 0.013 \pm 0.013 . Top snippet F1 remained in a relatively narrow range across the four batches with an average value of about 0.095 ± 0.008 \pm 0.008 . Both metrics are lower that respective preliminary results reported in the BioASQ 13, which were 0.323 ± 0.08 \pm 0.08 and 0.244 ± 0.021 \pm 0.021 , respectively [ 47 ] .
This can be related to the high percentage of questions from new experts (64%) in BioASQ 14, who have not contributed to the training dataset.

这可能是BioASQ 14中新专家(64%)提出的高问题,他们没有为培训数据集作出贡献。

blocks.en:
The top exact-answer performance of the participating systems is summarized in Table 9 for both Phase B and Phase A+.
In Phase B, the leading systems reached perfect yes/no macro-F1 in all four batches, while factoid MRR ranged from 0.400 to 0.588 and list F1 from 0.361 to 0.654.
In Phase A+, where systems were not given expert-selected relevant material, the best yes/no scores remained close to Phase B performance, whereas factoid and list scores were lower overall, highlighting that the retrieval of relevant material is a considerable limitation.

在B阶段,领先系统在所有四个批次中都达到了完美的是/否宏观F1,而实测的MRR从0.400到0.588,F1清单从0.361到0.654。

blocks.en: 4.2 Task Synergy 14
blocks.zh: 4.2 任务协同14

blocks.en:
In task Synergy 14 , the same evaluation measures used for task 14b are applied, while the information retrieval component considers only newly retrieved material, following the residual collection evaluation approach [ 65 ] .
In addition, due to the developing nature of the topics, no answer is available for all of the open questions in each round. Therefore, only the questions indicated as “answer ready” were evaluated for exact and ideal answers per round.

Table 10 presents the best performance obtained by participating systems per round in task Synergy 14 .
In Round 1, we started with 63 new questions; no questions were answer-ready, and no answers were received in this round, only relevant material.
The four-round dialogue between biomedical experts and QA systems in this task supported the progressive collection of enough relevant material to answer 61 of these 63 new questions (97%) and three additional questions from the previous version of the task that remained open.
In particular, for 48 questions (73%), the systems managed to provide at least one ideal answer, which was considered ground-truth quality by the respective expert.
Overall, the task aided the generation of exact and ideal answers to questions on developing topics, including the Cushing syndrome, cancer therapy, molecular genetics, infections and prophylaxis, diagnostics, and mental health.

blocks.en: 4.3 Task MultiClinSum-2
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 任务多ClinSum-2

blocks.en: In this second edition, a new detailed evaluation was designed with the objective of providing a more comprehensive and clinically-oriented summary assessment, going beyond the lexical and semantic metrics used in the first edition. For the submissions evaluation, automatically generated summaries were compared against reference summaries using a combined evaluation framework that integrates automatic summarization metrics with an LLM-as-judge approach, capturing both surface-level lexical overlap and semantic similarity alongside deeper clinical quality dimensions. The evaluation metrics considered are described below.
blocks.zh: 在第二版中,设计了一个新的详细评价,目的是提供更加全面和面向临床的总结评估,超越了第一版中使用的词汇和语义衡量标准. 就提交评价而言,将自动生成的摘要与参考摘要进行比较,使用一个综合评价框架,将自动汇总指标与LLM即时判断方法结合起来,同时记录表层词汇重叠和语义相似以及更深层次的临床质量。 所考虑的评价指标如下。

blocks.en: Participating systems presented a broad methodological diversity, with two main strategy identified. On one side, several teams applied fine-tuning approaches with varying degrees of complexity: some used parameter-efficient methods such as QLoRA [ 11 ] for supervised instruction tuning, others explored reinforcement learning through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 67 ] in order to optimize generated summaries quality based on lexical and factual consistency metrics, and one team opted for a continual pretraining step on medical-domain models before applying task-specific instruction tuning. On the other hand, a second group of teams approached the task through inference-only systems, focusing on prompt engineering, dynamic example retrieval, or even the addition of external structured knowledge such as medical ontologies or knowledge graphs.
blocks.zh: 参与系统在方法上具有广泛的多样性,确定了两个主要战略。 一方面,几个团队采用了不同程度的复杂度的微调方法:一些团队使用QLORA[11]等参数效率高的方法进行监督教学调试,其他团队则通过分组相对政策优化(GRPO)[67]探索强化学习,以根据词汇和事实一致性衡量标准优化生成的总结质量,一个团队选择在应用特定任务教学调试之前对医学领域模型持续进行预训. 另一方面,第二组团队通过只推论系统来完成这项任务,侧重于即时工程,动态实例检索,甚至添加外部结构化知识,如医学本体学或知识图.

blocks.en: The evaluation results for each language sub-track are summarized in Table 11 , showing the top-2 performing teams per language ranked by BERTScore. Team ixa-sum, with their GRPO-based system, consistently ranked first across most sub-tracks on both lexical and semantic metrics, suggesting a clear advantage over other strategies. Other systems such as NLP4Health and MediScribes achieved notable performance on LLM-as-judge clinical dimensions, particularly completeness and faithfullness . In terms of lower-resource languages, team DACHausa was the main participating team, providing the only submission in Greek, Czech and Danish. Regarding LLM-as-judge evaluation, consistency was the weakest clinical dimension, suggesting the limited capability of submitted systems to generate equivalent summaries across different language versions.

blocks.en: 4.4 Task BioNNE-R
blocks.zh: 4.4 任务BioNNE-R

blocks.en: As an official baseline, we provide a relation classifier built on the OpenNRE framework [ 22 ] with a bert-base-multilingual-cased backbone [ 12 ] . Each candidate entity pair is encoded with special entity markers inserted around the head and tail spans, and classified into one of the 14 relation types or a no_relation class. For each candidate pair, the minimal sentence segment surrounding the two entities is extracted as model input. Training data is constructed by enumerating gold entity pairs and adding negative (no_relation) examples at a 3:1 negative-to-positive ratio, with candidate pairs constrained to entity-type combinations permitted by the annotation schema. Separate checkpoints were trained for the English, Russian, and bilingual tracks, the latter on the concatenation of the English and Russian training data.
blocks.zh: 作为官方的基线,我们提供一个基于OpenNRE框架的关系分类器[22],其中有一个bert-base-多语种主干线[12]. 每个候选实体配对被编码,在头部和尾部的间隙周围插入特殊实体标记,并归类为14种关系类型之一或无关系类. 对于每个候选对子,将围绕两个实体的最小句子部分提取出来作为模型输入. 培训数据是通过列举黄金实体对数和在3:1负对正比中加入负(无关系)实例来构建的,候选对数受注释计划允许的实体类型组合限制. 为英语、俄语和双语轨道分别培训了检查站,后者涉及英语和俄语培训数据的汇总。

blocks.en: Systems were evaluated against the gold relation annotations using precision, recall, and F1-score. Given the highly imbalanced relation-type distribution, macro-averaged F1 across relation types was adopted as the official ranking metric, computed independently for each subtask.
blocks.zh: 使用精确度、召回率和F1-分数对照黄金关系说明评价了系统。 鉴于关系类型分布极不平衡,采用各种关系类型中宏观平均F1作为官方排名衡量标准,为每个子任务独立计算。

blocks.en: Table 12 reports macro-F1 for the best submission of each team. All participating systems substantially outperformed the baseline, yet scores cluster in a narrow 0.44–0.53 band across subtasks, indicating considerable headroom for nested relation extraction. ELiRF-UPV achieved the best English result (0.5060), while LODAC-NII led on both the Russian (0.5283) and bilingual (0.5015) subtasks, with only a 0.0044 margin separating the two top English systems. Despite the much larger Russian training set, Russian and English scores were comparable and among the five teams that entered both subtasks, the mean macro-F1 was 0.4858 for Russian against 0.4866 for English, although the single best Russian score (0.5283) did exceed the best English one. The document-level graph approach and the typed-marker pair-classification approaches performed comparably, with no approach type showing a clear advantage.

blocks.en: The results show a relatively competitive top tier, with stanimeros achieving the best overall performance (F1 = 0.8667) using an ensemble-based approach that also yields the highest precision (0.8830), indicating strong balance between correct predictions and error control. Very closely behind, Georgios_1 reaches an F1 of 0.8638, suggesting that different high-quality modeling strategies converge in performance at the top end. A mid-performing cluster includes LSI_UNED and alikibliona, with F1 scores around 0.83–0.82, reflecting solid but less optimized systems. Below them, several systems (elcardiocc, Pakakisd, and fernandogd97) converge around 0.76 F1, but with notably different trade-offs: for example, the baseline BERT system prioritizes precision (0.9036) at the cost of recall, whereas others such as max_micro_curriculum favor recall more strongly. Overall, ensemble and correction-heavy methods clearly dominate the leaderboard, while simpler or single-model approaches tend to trade off precision and recall more unevenly, leading to lower or less balanced F1 scores.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
This paper provides an overview of the fourteenth BioASQ challenge.
This year, BioASQ consisted of six tasks:
(i) Task 14b on biomedical semantic question answering.
(ii) Task Synergy14 on question answering for developing biomedical topics.
(iii) Task MultiClinSum-2 on multilingual clinical summarization.
(iv) Task BioNNE-R on relation extraction between nested named entities in Russian and
English.
(v) Task ELCardioCC on clinical coding in cardiology.
(vi) Task GutBrainIE on gut-brain interplay information extraction.

blocks.en:
The results for task 14b indicate that the strongest participant systems achieved high scores, particularly for yes/no answer generation, even in Phase A+, where expert-selected relevant material was not provided, which is in alignment with task 13b. For list and factoid questions, performance remains less consistent, especially in Phase A+, leaving clear room for further improvement. For these question types, access to expert-selected relevant material appears to help systems produce higher-quality answers.
These results also underline the importance of Phase A, which evaluates automatic retrieval of relevant material and shows variability across batches and a performance drop in task 14b, where more questions by new experts were included, compared to task 13b.
Participants applied a diverse range of retrieval and generation strategies, including traditional methods, LLM and agent-based frameworks, multi-stage and ensembling techniques, and domain-specific knowledge integration.
The Synergy14 results, consistent with earlier editions, suggest that current systems can support biomedical scientists seeking specialized information on developing problems, while still leaving room for further advances.
blocks.zh:
任务14b的结果表明,最强的参与者系统取得了很高的分数,特别是在 " 是 " / " 无 " 答案生成 " 方面,甚至在A+阶段,没有提供专家选定的相关材料,这与任务13b是一致的。 就清单和事实问题而言,业绩仍然不太一致,特别是在A+阶段,为进一步改进留下了明确的余地。 对于这些问题类型,获得专家选定的相关材料似乎有助于系统提供质量更高的答案。
这些结果也突出表明了A阶段的重要性,该阶段评价了有关材料的自动检索,并显示不同批次的变异,任务14b的性能下降,与任务13b相比,增加了新专家提出的问题。
与会者应用了各种检索和生成战略,包括传统方法、LLM和代理框架、多阶段和综艺技术以及特定领域知识的整合。
与前几版一致的Synergy14结果表明,目前的系统可以支持生物医学科学家寻求关于所出现问题的专门信息,同时仍然留有进一步进步的空间.

blocks.en: The MultiClinSum-2 task focuses on the automatic summarization of clinical case reports across 15 languages, providing a comprehensive multilingual benchmark and evaluation framework to foster the development of automatic summarization systems capable of processing diverse clinical narratives within different linguistic contexts. The task received a total of 9 participating teams, with the highest participation concentrated in languages with greater resource availability such as English, Spanish or Portuguese. Participant systems showed rich and diverse methodological approaches, ranging from prompt engineering and agentic inference pipelines augmented with external biomedical knowledge such as UMLS, to parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategies such as QLoRA or reinforcement learning via GRPO. A key addition of this second edition is the introduction of an enhanced evaluation framework combining lexical and semantic summarization metrics with LLM-as-judge approaches, under which participating systems achieved notable results across all sub-tracks on both assessment dimensions.
blocks.zh: MultiClinSum-2任务侧重于15种语言的临床病例报告自动汇总,提供了一个全面的多语种基准和评价框架,以促进开发能够处理不同语言背景下不同临床叙事的自动汇总系统. 这项任务共接待了9个参与小组,参与人数最多的是英语、西班牙语或葡萄牙语等资源较多的语言。 参与系统显示出丰富多样的方法,从利用诸如UMLS等外部生物医学知识的迅速工程和代理推论管道,到诸如QLORA等参数效率微调战略或通过GRPO进行强化学习。 第二版的一个重要补充是采用了一个强化的评价框架,将词汇学和语义归纳计量法与LLM即时判断法结合起来,根据该框架,参与系统在两个评估层面的所有次级轨道上都取得了显著成果。

blocks.en: The BioNNE-R task evaluated the extraction of relations between nested named entities in Russian and English biomedical texts. Seven teams participated, most framing the task as pair classification with typed entity markers and fine-tuned transformers, alongside one document-level graph model and LLM-based systems. All submissions outperformed the multilingual baseline, but the best macro-F1 scores stayed near 0.50–0.53, showing that relation extraction over nested entities remains an open challenge.
blocks.zh: BioNRE-R任务评价了巢命名实体在俄语和英语生物医学文本中关系的提取. 7个小组参加,大多数小组将任务设定为有打字实体标记和微调变压器的对等分类,同时采用一个文件级图表模型和基于LLM的系统。 所有提交材料都超过了多语种基线,但最佳的宏观-F1分数保持在0.50-0.53左右,这表明在嵌套实体上提取关系仍然是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: The ELCardioCC task centered on extracting and classifying medical entities from Greek discharge letters, drawing participation from six teams who submitted a diverse set of systems. Overall, the results show a clear shift toward hybrid pipelines and ensemble-based systems that combine NER, entity linking, and ICD-10 classification to better capture clinical semantics. Strong performance is consistently achieved by models that integrate multiple strategies and leverage Greek-specific transformer backbones, especially when combined with optimization techniques to address class imbalance. While simpler BERT-based baselines remain competitive, they are generally outperformed by more complex ensemble and knowledge-enhanced approaches. This indicates that combining structured clinical knowledge with multi-model fusion is key to achieving robust and accurate ICD-10 coding in this task.
blocks.zh: ELCardioCC的任务集中于从希腊放行信件中提取和分类医疗实体,吸引提交了一套不同系统的6个小组的参与。 总体来看,结果显示明显转向混合管和综艺系统,将NER,实体连接和ICD-10分类结合起来,以便更好地捕捉临床语义学. 强性能通过整合多种策略,利用希腊特有的变压器骨干,尤其是结合优化技术,解决阶级失衡的模型来持续实现. 虽然较简单的基于BERT的基线仍然具有竞争力,但一般而言,这些基线因更复杂的组合和知识强化办法而表现优于业绩。 这表明,将结构化的临床知识与多模式聚变相结合,对于在这项任务中实现稳健准确的ICD-10编码至关重要.

blocks.en:
The GutBrainIE task, centered on information extraction for the gut-brain axis, challenged participants with Named Entity Recognition and increasingly fine-grained Relation Extraction subtasks.
Teams achieving the strongest performance employed supervised deep-learning strategies, combining pretrained biomedical language models with ensemble strategies.
Only a few participants experimented with prompt-based or generative approaches; however, these generally obtained lower scores, confirming the need to develop specialized models to effectively extract complex entities and relations in a specific biomedical domain.
blocks.zh:
古特布莱恩 以沟脑轴信息提取为核心的IE任务对参与者提出了命名实体识别和日益精细的提取关系子任务的挑战.
采用监督的深入学习战略,将训练有素的生物医学语言模式与共同战略相结合,实现最强业绩的团队。
只有少数参与者尝试了即时或基因方法;然而,这些参与者普遍获得较低的分数,证实需要开发专门模型,以有效提取特定生物医学领域的复杂实体和关系.

blocks.en:
Overall, BioASQ 14 brought together 87 distinct teams across established and newer tasks, with substantial participation in all six tracks.
Several participating systems achieved competitive performance, and some improved over baselines or previous state-of-the-art results.
In line with earlier editions, BioASQ continues to push research forward in semantic indexing, question answering, information extraction, and language processing in biomedicine, offering both long-running and newer tasks.
The challenge first expanded beyond English biomedical literature with MESINESP [ 16 ] , and it has continued to broaden its scope since then. In its fourteenth edition, BioASQ included MultiClinSum-2 [ 62 ] , BioNNE-R [ 63 ] , ELCardioCC [ 14 ] , and GutBrainIE [ 41 ] , alongside the established 14b and Synergy14 tasks.
As a result, BioASQ 14 covered fifteen languages, multiple document types (biomedical articles, clinical case reports, and discharge letters), and specialized biomedical domains such as gut-brain interaction and cardiology.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,BioASQ 14汇集了87个不同的团队,这些团队在既定任务和较新的任务之间,在所有六个轨道上都有实质性的参与。
一些参与系统取得了竞争性业绩,一些系统比基线或以往的最新结果有所改善。
根据早期版本,BioASQ继续推进生物医学中语义索引,问答,信息提取和语言处理的研究,同时提供长期和较新的任务.
挑战首先超越了英语生物医学文献与MESINESP[16],此后它继续扩大其范围. 在第十四版中,BioASQ包括MultiClinSum-2 [62],BioNNE-R [63],ELCardioCC [14],和GutBraie [41],同时完成了既定的14b和Synergy14任务.
因此,BioASQ 14涵盖15种语言,多种文件类型(生物医学文章,临床病例报告和出院函),以及专门的生物医学领域,如肠脑相互作用和心脏病学.

blocks.en: Future directions for BioASQ include further expanding QA benchmark datasets through community-driven processes, broadening the network of biomedical experts involved, and enlarging the range of resources used across BioASQ tasks. This includes additional document types, more languages, and further specialized subdomains within biomedicine.
blocks.zh: BioASQ的未来方向包括通过社区驱动的进程进一步扩大质量评估基准数据集,扩大所涉生物医学专家网络,以及扩大在BioASQ任务中使用的资源范围。 这包括额外的文件类型,更多的语言,以及生物医学中进一步的专业化子领域.
